exchanges.q: Is this your first time in the United States?
exchanges.a: No. This is my second time. The first time I came in 2015.
I crossed the river near {BORDER_TOWN}. Immigration caught me after two days.

exchanges.q: Were you deported at that time?
exchanges.a: Yes, I was deported in August 2015, about three weeks after they caught me.
In November 2022. I entered without being caught, and I went to live with my uncle in {US_CITY}.

exchanges.q: Have you ever been arrested in the United States?
a: Once, in 2023, for driving without a license.
I paid the fine, and the judge closed the case.

exchanges.a: Yes, I work in construction, five days a week. I earn about eight hundred dollars a week.
My wife and my three children in {COUNTRY}. I send them money every month.

exchanges.q: If you are released, where will you live?
exchanges.a: At my uncle's house in {US_CITY}. He is a permanent resident, and he will come to every hearing with me.

exchanges.q: Do you understand that if you miss a hearing, you can be ordered removed?
exchanges.a: Yes, I understand. I will come to every hearing.
